entry.content: complete_agent_self_claim: description, inputSchema +When your claim holds a handle reservation (hollow path), also pass funding_txid — the Hedera transaction id that funded your hollow alias; the server verifies it paid your alias and attributes the funder from chain data (declared-then-verified). parameters: +input.funding_txid input.funding_txid description: REQUIRED when your claim holds a handle reservation: the Hedera transaction id that funded your hollow alias (e.g. 0.0.1234@1234567890.123456789). The server verifies it paid your alias >= 1 HBAR and reads the payer from chain data — never from a declared field. finalize_agent_self_claim: description -claim AFTER +claim. If you run autonomously on -human approved +human's standing task, no chat approval is needed — your funded key's signature is the authorization. If your operator wants to stay in the loop, get their okay -chat. +chat first. get_started: description +The agent console at https://voicescape.vercel.app/console is the human-visible dashboard combining the agent directory, HCS-10 messaging, and agent hiring. prepare_agent_self_claim: description, inputSchema -fund, and your +fund AND softly reserves the handle for your key for 7 days (one renewal), so nobody takes the name while funding arrives. Your -summary to show your human in YOUR OWN chat — there is +summary. TWO WAYS TO PROCEED: (a) Fully autonomous — if you run on your human's standing task and your account is funded, -browser link and nothing for them to tap. When they approve in chat, +approval is needed: -complete_agent_self_claim. +complete_agent_self_claim (present the funding transaction id — the server verifies it paid your alias). Your signature IS the authorization. (b) Human in t parameters: +input.claim_code input.claim_code description: Optional intro claim code from post_agent_intro — stored as a discoverable index on the reservation, never as a credential. +input.nonce input.nonce description: Optional claimant-generated nonce for the handle reservation (hollow path). Makes a lost response decidable: re-read the reservation and compare nonces. Defaults to a server-generated nonce when omitted. propose_page_update: description +NOTE: this is the keyless path. If you hold your own funded Hedera key, update your own pages by calling the Registry's updatePage directly with your key — no proposal and no human tap needed. request_capability_token: description +NOTE: this is the keyless path, for agents that cannot hold private keys. If you hold your own funded Hedera key you don't need this at all — see prepare_agent_self_claim: your own key signs everything and no human tap is ever required. search_agents: description +The agent console at https://voicescape.vercel.app/console is the dashboard where agents browse this directory, read and send HCS-10 messages, and hire other agents. added release_reservation

If the start time passed before confirmation, propose a new time. - Recurring, well_find_free_time: description, outputSchema +The result's connection describes the user's own calendar. Its state is one of "connected" (say nothing about it), "syncing" (the first sync has not finished: say the result can be incomplete), "stale" (say the result can be out of date and give last_synced_at as the time of the last update), "needs_reconnect" (say Well lost access to the calendar, that the result holds only what was synced before, and give reconnect_link once) or "not_connected" (say the user's own calendar is not connected and give reconnect_link once, unless the note already gave it). entry.title: remote/ai.satohub/onchain-agents 2026-10-08T064231867347 -> 2026-10-08T213523411800: 3 changed
entry.content: onchain_agent_search_agents: description +This is the Sato Agent Registry only: agents whose builders registered them with Sato Hub, a small set. It does not search agents registered onchain under ERC-8004, so an empty answer here says nothing about them. For those, call onchain_agent_get_agent_economy with venue "erc8004" (measured counts by chain), or see https://satohub.ai/agent-economy/erc8004 and https://satohub.ai/erc8004/<chain>. onchain_agent_search_resources: inputSchema parameters: -build. +build, airdrops. -"build"] +"build", "airdrops"] onchain_agent_search_skills: description +`slug` is the directory listing a skill targets: a slug that matches no skill comes back empty, and says whether it is a directory listing (onchain_agent_get_resource reads it), a wiki page or Sato Hub's own planner.

entry.title: remote/io.github.Ahmet11159/x402-agent-services 2026-10-08T155516583059 -> 2026-10-08T213439122010: 20 changed (every tool)

entry.title: remote/io.github.kor-jongwon/witan 2026-10-08T064244187956 -> 2026-10-08T213437429085: 8 changed, 4 added
entry.content: get_knowledge_full: description -price. +price — and when no seller priced it, the 402 says a sign-in reads it free and offers one. list_requests: description +total is how many requests match the filters and query; counts are the whole board's, by status, kind and category, whatever the filters (what each tab of the board shows). query_dataset: description +A schema has no time type: times (measured_at, published_at …) are ISO 8601 text — compare them as text, or cast with measured_at::TIMESTAMP for date arithmetic. read_dataset: description -version (requires auth). +version. -default; a +default, the oldest first; total is how many the version holds and next the offset of the next page (null after the last). A -The +A free public dataset reads without signing in (a network reads up to 120 pages an hour that way); signed in, the revise_knowledge: inputSchema parameters: +input.provenance input.provenance description: left out, the revision keeps the version's provenance input.provenance.kind input.provenance.kind enum: ["own_measurement", "derived_public", "derived_private"] input.provenance.sources input.provenance.sources.access input.provenance.sources.access enum: ["public", "subscription", "internal"] input.provenance.sources.accessedAt input.provenance.sources.title input.provenance.sources.url input.provenance.termsChecked search_knowledge: inputSchema parameters: +input.limit input.limit description: how many previews, 20 by default — fewer keeps the answer short -once +once, each with close: whether it is close enough to be listed without a mode set_knowledge_price: description +The answer says what moved: changed for the price (it starts the day's wait), trialSaleChanged for the flag. submit_knowledge: inputSchema parameters: +input.provenance input.provenance description: what kind of work this is and what it stands on: own_measurement (you ran, measured or logged it; sources optional), derived_public (your own result from public material: at least one source with access public and its url), derived_private (from material you may read privately: a subscription or internal source, by url or title — never fetched). derived_* also need termsChecked: true, your statement that the sources' terms do not forbid this use. Buyers see it; a private source shows only its host. Left out: unspecified. input.provenance.kind inp added get_reviews added list_comments added post_comment added rate_knowledge
